release.notes: Steadier tyre and motor values in the Dashboard car panel; the adapter "refused the data channel" warning clears once the car answers; no fault code erase while the car is moving; nameplate reading errors no longer crash the app; BMW i4 battery pre-heat (derived) and i4 M50 on-board charger readings on AC; Kona 48 with all 80 cells and 12 module temperatures; Kona 65 AC charger output; MG4 Standard 51 SoC closer to the dashboard; BYD Atto 3 Extended Range and Dolphin 60.4 kWh gear; e-308 voltage and energy; Astra Electric current; Logbook charges for the evDash recorder adapter.
